data.name: Mobin
data.gender_notes: Mobin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'mobin', meaning 'intelligent' or 'wise'. This name is often used to describe individuals with exceptional intellect and understanding. The name Mobin carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mobin usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes wisdom and knowledge in the path of Allah.
data.etymology: Mobin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mobin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
